note: Smart skip prototype: at departure, predict whether the next stop will have any stock/output when the carrier arrives; if not, skip the service stop (the road leg is unchanged). 6 h simulated at 0.1 s steps, median of 4 runs, current manual-load/unload model.
reading: Skip-service cuts services by ~50%, but wall time is flat (+2-4%) because building/worker/carrier movement dominates. Throughput is not a clear win: cart 8 improved slightly, cart 6 fell 17%. The prediction can skip a stop whose output appears just after arrival, and it adds a decision that must be stored in the snapshot.
